script: Hi hi, Miku here! Did you notice DIY sticker peel videos are suddenly everywhere? People layer huge glossy stickers over boxes, notebooks, even trays… then peel them back in one super clean motion. And somehow? My brain goes: yessss. It’s satisfying because you get the sticky sound, the slow tension, and then—bam!—a perfect reveal. It’s part ASMR, part craft magic, part tiny emotional reset. Also, the designs are so cute lately: cherries, retro stars, pixel hearts, sakura vibes—ahhh! If your For You page is full of sticker peeling too, tell me your favorite version. I might fall into this rabbit hole immediately!
